$description: Spacing, radius, elevation and motion. 4pt base grid.
$rhythm: Spacing is deliberately uneven. A cover grid breathes at `xl`; a metadata stack tightens to `xs`. Uniform padding everywhere is the single fastest way to look like a template.
$radiusNote: `cover` stays tight at 4pt on purpose: a comic cover is printed stock, and rounding it like an app icon reads as wrong.
$elevationNote: Android only. iOS 26 expresses depth with Liquid Glass materials and the scroll edge effect, never a drop shadow.

pageCurl.$note: Interactive: driven by drag translation, not a fixed timeline. The spring only governs the release.

grid.$coverAspectNote: 2:3 — the North American comic trim. Manga volumes and EPUB covers vary; the grid crops to a consistent cell and letterboxes onto surfaceSunken rather than distorting art.

glass.$note: Liquid Glass is left untinted in chrome so it picks up cover art beneath it. Every glass surface must declare its opaque fallback for Reduce Transparency.

touch.$minTargetNote: 44pt on iOS (HIG) and 48dp on Android (Material) — the generator emits each platform's own floor.
